name: Remote MCP Server on Cloudflare
description: A template for deploying remote Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers to Cloudflare Workers using Server-Sent Events without authentication. It allows users to define custom tools and connect them to clients like Cloudflare AI Playground or Claude Desktop.
